events.name: M8 Magnet C
events.text: I am making room for the aftermath.

events.name: M8 Shield C
events.text: Your request has been escalated to ordnance.

events.name: M8 Utility C
events.text: I asked the moon for guidance. it said fire.

events.name: M8 Jet C
events.text: I have filed my complaint in high explosive.

events.name: M8 Magnet C
events.text: The cannon gets top billing.

events.name: M8 Shield C
events.text: This is a very small apocalypse by appointment.

events.name: M8 Utility C
events.text: I AM ABOUT TO HAVE A VERY MEMORABLE IDEA.

events.name: M8 Jet C
events.text: This is my inside voice, amplified.

events.name: M8 Magnet C
events.text: The landscape needs more crunch.

events.name: M8 Shield C
events.text: The gods have terrible trigger discipline.

events.name: M8 Utility C
events.text: I HAVE A PERMIT FOR THIS PARTICULAR NONSENSE.

events.name: M8 Jet C
events.text: Let us find out if armor is oven-safe.

events.name: M8 Magnet C
events.text: I am excavating a better argument.

events.name: M8 Shield C
events.text: I call this the crater casserole.

events.name: M8 Utility C
events.text: The barbecue is now self-service.

events.name: M8 Jet C
events.text: I have been saving this shell for someone taller.

events.name: M8 Magnet C
events.text: This is not the factory-recommended greeting.

events.name: M8 Shield C
events.text: Your position is statistically inconvenient.

events.name: M8 Jet C
events.text: Hot stuff, coming through the stratosphere.

events.name: M8 Magnet C
events.text: The neighborhood is getting a water feature. maybe.

events.name: M8 Shield C
events.text: I am optimizing away your cover.

events.name: M8 Jet C
events.text: This is the executive version of knocking.

events.name: M8 Magnet C
events.text: That hill is not in my calculations.

events.name: M8 Shield C
events.text: Please stop replying all with artillery.

events.name: M8 Jet C
events.text: I have some notes on the landscaping.

events.name: M8 Magnet C
events.text: Let history blame the wind.

events.name: M8 Shield C
events.text: Please expect some service disruption.

events.name: M8 Jet C
events.text: The choreography calls for scattering.

events.name: M8 Magnet C
events.text: I did not come this far to aim sensibly.

events.name: M8 Shield C
events.text: My quest marker is floating over your tank.

events.name: M8 Jet C
events.text: The free sample is also the full size.

events.name: M8 Magnet C
events.text: This should get the stakeholders moving.

events.name: M8 Shield C
events.text: Today we learn who owns the hill.

events.name: M8 Jet C
events.text: Your application to remain here was denied.

events.name: M8 Magnet C
events.text: Return to sender is strongly discouraged.

events.name: M8 Shield C
events.text: Please do not shake the contents.

events.name: M8 Magnet C
events.text: Tell the producer I need another tank.

events.name: M8 Jet C
events.text: The view from here needs fewer obstructions.

events.name: M8 Shield C
events.text: I am leaving a lasting depression.
